g.text: Static calibration in the tested mechanical corner
Same physical plant and identified inverse: k = 23.6952 N/mm, c = 48 N·s/m; S = 2 kg; 50 N; 90°; μ = 0.3.
Only 16 static residuals are halved. Noise, acquisition/timing, robot residuals and PI/current tuning remain fixed.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Worst recorded margin improves from 0.0470 N to 0.1231 N across these three paired seeds.
All six force/packing records pass. Scope: three paired seeds at one heavy combined corner; the nominal 3,500-case design stays fixed.
Evidence: 400,001 native samples per full recording. Both sets use known actual k/c; the longer nominal-mechanics runs are a separate cohort.
